metadata.note: Rail transit in Miami-Dade County. Metrorail opened on 20 May 1984 between Dadeland South and Overtown, reached Okeechobee in 1985 and Palmetto in 2003; the Orange Line and its AirportLink branch to Miami International Airport followed on 28 July 2012. The free downtown Metromover people mover opened on 17 April 1986 and gained its Omni and Brickell loops in 1994. The separate MIA Mover has linked the airport to the Miami Intermodal Center since 2011. Under Rule 4 every Miami-Dade Transit line carries one colour even though the agency brands them Green and Orange.
